Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>

Subject: Intro + quick technical touchpoint before demo

Hi Samir —

Thanks for signing up and for the interest in Redwood Inference. Before we schedule a full product demo, our solutions lead (Irene, cc'd) usually does a quick 15-minute technical touchpoint to scope integration needs and confirm the right demo focus. This helps us make the full demo actionable and avoid re-runs.

Are you available for a brief call in the next two business days? A few windows (your timezone below):
- Wed Aug 8 — 10:00–10:30 PDT / 17:00–17:30 BST
- Wed Aug 8 — 15:00–15:30 PDT
- Thu Aug 9 — 09:00–09:30 PDT

If none of those work, feel free to pick a slot on our quick scheduler: https://calendly.com/redwood/15min-technical-screen

Quick context I have from your signup: Mercury Retail is evaluating a recommendation and search stack migration for your storefronts, wants low-latency embedding lookups, and has questions about VPC/private deployment for PII-sensitive logs. Irene — would you like to own the 15-min triage if Samir picks a time?

Best,
Aditya Rao
SDR, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Thanks — quick is perfect. I can do Wed Aug 8 at 15:00 PDT (that aligns with our engineering lead's afternoon). Please note we are in EST for most of the US office (so that would be 18:00 EST for us) — apologies for the timezone noise.

I've also attached a short infrastructure snapshot that shows our current search infra and where we plan to place inference (cloud + on-prem cache). It includes a couple of network questions we want to confirm during the call.

- network egress and private link options
- tokenization/embedding size estimates for our catalog (1.2M items)

Great, Wed Aug 8 at 15:00 PDT works for me. I'll send a calendar invite for a 15-minute technical triage. Quick agenda so we stay tight:

- 0–3 min: introductions / current search topology (you)
- 3–9 min: network & deployment constraints (private link, VPC peering, egress)
- 9–14 min: rough perf guidance & whether we should schedule a scoped benching session
- 14–15 min: next steps / handoff to demo (full demo + engineering workshop)

Prep (optional): if you have a short sample of a typical document or product metadata payload, that helps us estimate tokenization/embedding size quickly (paste in the calendar event or bring to the call).

I created a provisional Google Meet invite: https://meet.google.com/redwood-quick-15
I'll attach a one-page pre-demo checklist to the calendar invite as well.

See you Wed —
